name: frames
description: Key frames of a local video file with their timestamps, from ffmpeg scene detection.

verbs.name: get
verbs.description: The first frame plus one JPEG at each scene change. Prints one time and path per line, or the frame set with --json. Cached by file hash and threshold.

video.description: Local video file, such as the path download get --video prints.

threshold.description: Scene score from 0 to 1 above which a frame starts a new scene. Lower finds more frames.
